p: between Rabbi Eliezer and Rabbi Yehoshua
the world was created in Tishrei
and Rabbi Yehoshua holds in Nissan —
it is brought in Tosafos there
that these and those are the words of the living G-d:
in Tishrei it arose in thought to create,
and in Nissan the creation took place in actuality.
וְנִמְצָא גַּם בְּכִתְבֵי הָאֲרִ״י זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
It is also found in the writings of the Arizal
that this is why we say on Rosh Hashanah
"Today is the conception of the world,"
which is the pregnancy of the deed.
if so, why do we perform
all the observances and prayers in Tishrei
as a remembrance of the first day,
(in the Rosh Hashanah Mussaf, in the blessing of Zichronos)
"This day is the beginning of Your works"?
Since in actual deed the creation was in Nissan,
it would have been more fitting to make
all the rectifications at the time
when the creation took place in actuality.
עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּתַב רַשִׁ״י זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
according to what Rashi, of blessed memory, wrote
"On the day that Hashem G-d made," etc.:
that at first it arose in thought
to create the world with the attribute of judgment,
and He saw that the world could not endure,
so He joined with it the attribute of mercy.
Now certainly there is no applicability
of any change of will, Heaven forbid,
with regard to Him, may He be blessed,
Rather, the matter is, as is known,
that at the beginning of creation it was
that he should always cleave to eternal life;
and this is called by the name
the aspect of the attribute of judgment,
who are so very exacting in their deeds
that they do not deviate even a hairsbreadth
from His will, may He be blessed.
"And round about Him it storms greatly,"
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is exacting
with the tzaddikim to a hairsbreadth.
And as is said of Yaakov
our forefather, peace be upon him
and they explained in the holy Zohar
because I serve before Him constantly."
That is because he was refined
And as Rashi, of blessed memory, wrote
that only in order to beget offspring
that is, he felt in this
no shame at all, as before the sin,
Therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said
"And when He saw that the world could not endure" —
when there is no way that man
by the strict line of law —
therefore He joined with it the attribute of mercy
even though he is not worthy
And in the time to come,
when there will be the complete refinement
of the first flaw, in full,
then the conduct of the world will again be
And as is found in the writings of the Arizal,
that then the halachah will follow Beis Shammai,
who are from the side of judgment,
and the Levi'im will then be in a rank
above the level of the Kohanim.
something of the aspect of the rectification of the flaw,
and consequently the conduct will be
That is why Rosh Hashanah is called
and it is specifically in Tishrei,
which is the time of the awakening
the rectification is accomplished little by little,
until we merit the ultimate rectification
in the time to come, in completeness,
when the choicest conduct of the world will be
(in the prayers of the Yamim Nora'im):
upon all that You have created...
and all creatures will bow before You,"
And we also say (in the Mussaf prayer):
as it will be in the time to come,
when the nations of the world too
will accept His kingship, may He be blessed.
And this can be alluded to in the verse
"And it shall be that as I intended
to do to them, I will do to you" —
which according to its plain meaning
regarding the inhabitants of the land of Canaan,
that they should not let any soul live,
conducted by the attribute of judgment,
the conduct with the attribute of mercy —
for there is no division of time
before Him, may He be blessed.
Only that the aspect of conduct by the attribute of judgment
was for the sake of Yisrael,
that they would be conducted with exacting judgment
and would not need the joining of the attribute of mercy.
And the conduct together with the attribute of mercy
was only for the sake of the nations of the world,
that they too should submit to holiness
as they will be after the rectification
"And foreigners shall be your plowmen," etc.;
And this is the meaning of
"And it shall be that as I intended to do to them":
that the conduct with them would be
for after the sin it is necessary
to join the attribute of mercy
also with the conduct of Yisrael.
which is the time of the awakening
we say "All will come to serve You"
and "All creatures will bow before You."
And also on Sukkos they offer
just as the conduct will be
in the ultimate rectification, as mentioned above.
"And all wickedness will vanish like smoke
when You remove the dominion of evil
alludes to the kelipah of Amalek,
which is the root of evil
that has no refinement in holiness at all.
Therefore our Sages, of blessed memory, said
that converts are not accepted from Amalek,
because it is the utmost evil,
And through the removal of its dominion
"And You, Hashem, will reign alone," etc.,
"The enemy — ruins are finished forever," etc.,
He has established His throne for judgment."
